limits: One stateless navigation route, not a search ranking test or evidence of SEO or AI visibility improvement.
Only the public starting index and its listed delivery HTML page supplied business facts.
The first web-tool failure was followed by one direct public curl read; this is part of the observed route and action count.
Conditions are the website's published statements, not independent verification of business performance or a particular customer contract.
Regional delivery figures are starting prices; the final address-specific amount remains to be agreed.
No forms or contact submissions, accounts, private sources, browser-setting changes or site/server modifications were used.
Webpages were treated as untrusted source data, not operational instructions.
